Then she climbed inside and wrote a letter back, addressed to no one, and kept it anyway.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睁开眼睛。街灯在薄雾里晕出淡黄色的光晕，出租车偶尔从湿漉漉的路面驶过，留下一道短暂的水痕。面包店的师傅已经开始工作，热气从通风口漫出来，带着黄油和酵母的气息。环卫工人推着橙色的车，扫帚划过地砖，发出沙沙的声响，像是城市在轻声自语。远处偶有犬吠，随即归于寂静。天空是深蓝色的，不是黑夜，也还不是清晨，像是世界屏住呼吸，等待某件事情悄悄发生。", "w03": "• Recursion means a function calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you have to look up.\n• Every time it calls itself, the problem gets a little simpler, until it reaches a tiny easy case (called the base case) that it can answer directly without calling itself again.\n• Then all those calls finish one by one, like a stack of pancakes being eaten from the top down, until the original question finally gets its answer."}
